languageModelTools.name: agent-teams-handoff
languageModelTools.description: Delegates a routed task to an orchestrator agent in a new chat session. Before calling this tool, write the full assessment to Engram using engram_remember with key 'handoff:{taskId}'. This tool opens a new chat pre-filled with the target orchestrator.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool when you have finished analysing a task and need to delegate it to a specific orchestrator. First write your full assessment to Engram (key: 'handoff:{taskId}'). Then call this tool so a new chat session is opened with the orchestrator, which will recall the assessment from Engram.

targetAgentId.description: ID of the orchestrator agent to delegate to (e.g. 'backend-orchestrator')

taskId.description: Unique task identifier used as Engram key suffix, e.g. 'task-1741788000'

assessment.description: Brief summary of the task (used as the opening line in the new chat). Full assessment must already be in Engram.

supervised.description: When true (default), the chat is pre-filled but not auto-submitted, giving the user a chance to review. Set to false for fully automatic handoff.

languageModelTools.name: agent-teams-dispatch-parallel
languageModelTools.description: Fans out a task to multiple orchestrators in parallel. For each subtask, first write its context to Engram (key: 'task:{taskId}:subtask:{agentId}'). Opens one supervised chat per orchestrator and automatically opens the Aggregator when all complete.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this tool to dispatch a task to multiple orchestrators in parallel. REQUIRED parameters: `assessment` (string: one-line task summary) and `subtasks` (array of objects, each with `agentId` string and `description` string, minimum 2 items). Optional: `taskId` (string), `aggregatorAgentId` (string), `supervised` (boolean, default true). Example: { "assessment": "Implement payments feature", "subtasks": [{ "agentId": "frontend", "description": "React payments UI" }, { "agentId": "backend", "description": "Node API payments endpoints" }] }. Before calling this tool, write each sub-assessment to Engram using engram_remember with key 'task:{taskId}:subtask:{agentId}'.

taskId.description: Unique task identifier, e.g. 'task-1741788000'. Generated automatically if omitted.

assessment.description: One-line summary of the overall task. Each subtask's full context must already be in Engram.

subtasks.description: List of orchestrators to dispatch to (minimum 2).

description.description: Short description of this specific sub-task

aggregatorAgentId.description: ID of the aggregator agent to open when all subtasks complete (default: 'aggregator')

supervised.description: When true, chats are pre-filled but not auto-submitted. Defaults to false for parallel dispatch (each chat auto-executes immediately in its own session).

languageModelTools.name: agent-teams-complete-subtask
languageModelTools.description: Marks an orchestrator's subtask as completed in a parallel dispatch. Call this at the very end of your work.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call this tool LAST, after you have finished ALL your assigned work in a parallel dispatch session. REQUIRED: `taskId` (string: from your [Parallel:{taskId}] prompt prefix) and `agentId` (string: your own agent ID, e.g. 'frontend'). Optional: `summary` (string: brief summary of what you accomplished). Example: { "taskId": "task-1741788000", "agentId": "frontend", "summary": "Implemented React payments UI: 3 components, 1 hook" }. Calling this triggers the aggregator to open once all subtasks complete.

taskId.description: Task ID from your [Parallel:{taskId}] prompt prefix

summary.description: Brief summary of work completed (used by the aggregator)
